item.title: Army paratroopers ordered to Middle East as U.S. weighs next move in Iran conflict
item.summary: The orders follow weeks of speculation about whether the 82nd Airborne Division would join the war, after its headquarters unit abruptly pulled out of a training exercise this month.

item.title: Trump says U.S. is postponing some strikes as it negotiates end to war with Iran
item.summary: The president’s announcement sent markets up and energy prices diving, as investors bet Iran’s blockade of a key shipping chokepoint could soon end.

item.title: Trump hails Memphis crime drop as a win. Locals see a more complex reality.
item.summary: Crime has fallen, but officials and residents question how much credit the federal surge deserves — and whether the approach can deliver lasting change.

item.title: Senate Republicans pitch deal to end DHS shutdown, but Trump isn’t sold
item.summary: The deal under discussion would fund the department except for the part of Immigration and Customs Enforcement charged with arresting and deporting undocumented immigrants.

item.title: Oklahoma energy executive Alan Armstrong sworn in as U.S. senator
item.summary: Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt (R) appointed Armstrong to the Senate seat vacated by Sen. Markwayne Mullin (R), who was confirmed as homeland security secretary Monday.

item.title: Tracking who Trump is appointing to fill key administration roles
item.summary: Follow President Trump’s progress filling over 800 positions, among about 1,300 that require Senate confirmation, in this tracker from The Washington Post and the Partnership for Public Service.

item.title: Democrat scores upset win in Trump’s backyard for Florida state House seat
item.summary: Emily Gregory won the special election to represent a district that includes President Donald Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home, the Associated Press projected.

item.title: Prosecutor admits government lacks evidence of misconduct by Fed chair
item.summary: The admission during a closed-door hearing undercuts President Donald Trump’s claims of “criminality” in the central bank’s $2.5 billion office renovations.

item.title: Justices seem inclined to revive Trump policy blocking migrants at border
item.summary: The Supreme Court weighed a policy that would allow agents at U.S. borders to block migrants from entering the country to seek asylum.

item.title: Trump just voted by a method he calls ‘mail-in cheating’
item.summary: The president’s decision to vote by mail comes as he pushes a sweeping bill to reform balloting nationwide, including restrictions on mail-in voting.
